desc:
🐲 Catch pets, build a HUGE army & beat giant bosses!

How to Play:
👊 Punch wild pets to fight them
👻 Summon pets you beat into your army
💰 Earn money from your pets at home
🥁 Beat the drum to make your army stronger
👑 Defeat bosses to unlock new zones
✨ Discover rarer pets, sizes, and Divine pets!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
